the-voyages-of-captain-scott-retold-from: Charles Turley retells the epic Antarctic voyages of Captain Robert Falcon Scott — from the Discovery expedition to the tragic race for the South Pole. Drawing on Scott's own journals, he brings the heroism and heartbreak of polar exploration to vivid life. A stirring account of courage at the ends of the earth.
ancient-rome-from-the-earliest-times-dow: Robert F. Pennell's school history carries students from Rome's legendary founding — Romulus and Remus, the seven kings — through republic and empire down to the fall of the Western Empire in 476 A.D. Clear, compact, and well organized for classroom use, it served generations of students. A solid first march through two thousand years of Roman history.
